pages.text: Craft at a workbench. Two portions from a bone or suitable remains. Used in common elixirs.
Craft at a workbench. Wall decoration, with no combat effect. Breaking returns the item.
Craft at a workbench. Place on a solid surface. The contents have no effect; breaking returns the intact jar.
Craft at a workbench. A separate wall decoration made of bones and fangs. Does not replace existing monster head trophies.
The monster_essences tag accepts all 11 existing essences. Common necrophage, cursed and vampire elixirs accept any of them, but retain their specific remains. Rare recipes are unchanged.
